scope: All tracked SDK files at HEAD, including named historical captures; excludes untracked/generated output, external Cloud/deployed/exported consumers and planned work of other owners.
preserved_timer_capabilities: Canonical task and operation UUIDs, positive absolute deadline, exact bounded source bytes and parser/fuzzer independent admission checks.
Stable timer-fire key/body and exact original receipt after accepted append, lost acknowledgement, reopen and concurrent append; unkeyed retry negative remains.
Public Rust schedule/set_alarm and Wasm/TypeScript timerRecord/schedule/setAlarm authoring exports stay until their owning actor transition mapping is concrete.

alarm_migration.authority: One durable alarm generation per actor, committed with checkpoint; Keep/Set/Clear and consumed-generation fence.
alarm_migration.remaining: Bind each legacy task/operation timer to its actor/checkpoint and map authoring callbacks; multiple logical timers cannot be silently collapsed into one actor alarm.

har25_dispositions.status: Existing del-core1717 ownership; no duplicate deletion or credit here.
Existing del-coreH22 candidate; exported readiness/process helpers and namespace readiness tests retained pending exact caller/migration closure.
LIVE typed request/FileMention consumers in harness client, TUI, fuzz support and parity tests. No retirement.
LIVE bounded edit execution/authorization/registry consumers and refusal tests. No retirement.
Independent deterministic oracle and ambiguous-outcome recovery negative retained; test-only is not dead-code evidence.

json_dispositions.core: Extract existing DynamicMessage conversion; caller owns descriptor, pool, limits, product errors and semantic/result binding.
json_dispositions.machines_wire: Hosted DTOs currently use $bigint/$bytes and route-specific domain binding; canonical Protobuf JSON uses descriptor uint64/base64/message shapes. No silent format replacement without the actual server consumer join.
json_dispositions.elastic: ElasticCpu/ElasticMemory and elastic_cpu_ns remain in canonical Machines6002a7 contract/proto/grpc/simulator/usage. Atomic canonical retirement must precede deleting only JSON spellings.

retry_dispositions.terminal: Typed authority/credential/filter refusal is not retryable; preserve1713 and zero retry count.
retry_dispositions.unknown: Retain exact key/body and original admitted operation; inspect/reconcile Unknown rather than minting a key or resubmitting an unqueryable external side effect.
retry_dispositions.deadline: One whole-operation deadline covers credential resolution, connect, dispatch, body/stream, reconciliation and backoff; never restart it per attempt.

acceptance_plan_unexecuted: Compare identical original/candidate wire bytes, exact typed errors, complete next/preceding/watermark cuts and original provider/transport call trace; measure allocations/copied bytes separately from logical dispatch.
Retain same-key accepted-plus-lost-ack/reopen/retry histories and the original duplicate-publication/unkeyed negative; do not report simulator snapshots as physical crash durability.
Verify each nonretryable authority/credential/filter refusal produces zero retries under the actual transport.
Preserve exported-consumer startup/readiness/process-output tests, alarm generation/replacement/clear and external pause/claim invocation oracle.
Compile-only gate is the current admission policy. Runtime, performance, mutation and external/deployed consumer results remain unqualified until separately authorized and source-bound.
